info.title: v2.global_product.update_local_adjustment_rate
info.description: A multiplier that automatically converts your CB stock price into the local-warehouse price. It ensures your local inventory prices reflect regional costs, currency factors, and margin targets.

post.description: A multiplier that automatically converts your CB stock price into the local-warehouse price. It ensures your local inventory prices reflect regional costs, currency factors, and margin targets.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: adjustment_rate
parameters.description: The multiplier used to adjust the cross-border original price to local price

parameters.name: merchant_id
parameters.description: Shopee’s unique identifier for a merchant. Required for all merchant level requests(CB CNSC user calling global product related APIs).

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the shop to which the adjustment rate applies

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, merchant_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.
